[P2] Establish probe overlap before releasing either gate

The recovery check permits timely handler entry followed by a later `BLOCKED` event. A probe entering near `deadline + grace` can meet that contract but reach its gate after this unconditional peer release. `healthy_peer()` then fails its required live-overlap check despite valid recovery. Releasing the probe immediately upon `BLOCKED` can also prevent its first `ALIVE` record. After the fixed recovery window, wait for live gate overlap between the original peer and probe requests before releasing either gate, while preserving the existing handler-entry bound. Cover timely entry with delayed gate progress.
